transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to discuss the hot-work repair on Resin Dryer 2. As you know, the access-panel hinge is cracked and needs welding, and the dryer is adjacent to our active compounding area. Before I can authorize this repair, we need to complete the documented pre-job review with formal findings from all four functions — maintenance, environmental health and safety, production planning, and quality. I'd like each of you to provide your current findings and the controls you believe are needed so we can get your formal finding records submitted through the review process. Once all four are submitted and the required controls are recorded, I can authorize the permit. Who would like to start?

transcript.text: My inspection found that the hinge cannot be repaired in place — the replacement requires exactly 4 hours of welding and cooling, followed by a separate 30-minute panel-fit check.
